name: surface-remount-composition-listener-pending-dispose
description: A view mount registers its six listeners; the registrations of view-process-ended and view-reply stay pending while the surface is disposed. The pending registration of view-reply then resolves with an unsubscribe function that throws, and the pending registration of view-process-ended is refused.
reason: The registration of a listener belongs to a page, which the Go producer does not have (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
